title: quercus dalechampii var. aurea
intro: Quercus dalechampii var. aurea, commonly known as Golden Cork Oak, is a deciduous tree of the Quercus genus, characterized by its golden yellow leaves and edible acorns. The Golden Cork Oak has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestive health and boost the immune system, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving gut health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Quercus dalechampii var. aurea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
